business_delta: The baseline is accepted A01 byte-for-byte. Global-window keeps SIMPE=36, seed 1 and the 8-10 mission, sets Control.RCINT=.25, RCSTA=7.5, RCEND=9, and removes two optional ResultCollection rows. System-override keeps that global window but adds only a SYSTEM ResultCollection row RCINT=.5, RCSTA=0, RCEND=36. Descriptions label provenance.
diagnostic_provenance: The frozen v1.0.0 diagnostic triplet demonstrated that this installed -jsonreport exports SystemResults and StockTotalResults but no MissionResults table. Its original requirement for direct MISSION interval evidence is not satisfiable from that report. This v1.0.1 contract narrows the observable claim before three fresh guarded native runs; the diagnostic runs are excluded from publication evidence.
pre_run_hypothesis: All runs retain identical full event logs through the 8-10 mission and 36-hour horizon. Baseline SystemResults and StockTotalResults each cover 0-36 in 72 half-hour bins. Global-window changes both to six quarter-hour bins 7.5-9. The SYSTEM ResultCollection override restores only SystemResults to 0-36 half-hour bins while StockTotalResults remains on the global window. Interval state and stock quantities should agree with the event ledger. ResultSummary remains a full-simulation summary.
